title: Idioms
sub: Common idioms with meanings and use.

cards.def:
something very easy
हिंदी: बहुत आसान काम
examples: The exam was a piece of cake.
Fixing it was a piece of cake.
For her, cooking biryani is a piece of cake.
Once you learn the shortcut, the report is a piece of cake.

cards.def:
to start a conversation in an awkward situation
हिंदी: बातचीत की शुरुआत करना / झिझक तोड़ना
examples: He told a joke to break the ice.
A smile can break the ice.
The trainer started with a fun game to break the ice.
I broke the ice by asking about her hometown.

cards.word: hit the nail on the head
cards.def:
to describe exactly the right thing
हिंदी: बिल्कुल सही बात कहना
examples: You hit the nail on the head.
She hit the nail on the head about costs.
When he said we need better planning, he hit the nail on the head.
The review hit the nail on the head about the slow service.

cards.def:
very rarely
हिंदी: कभी-कभार / बहुत कम
examples: He visits once in a blue moon.
We eat out once in a blue moon.
My brother calls me once in a blue moon.
Our team gets a free lunch once in a blue moon.

cards.word: the ball is in your court
cards.def:
it is your turn to act
हिंदी: अब फ़ैसला आपके हाथ में है
examples: I've made my offer; the ball is in your court.
The ball is in their court now.
I've sent my resume; now the ball is in the recruiter's court.
We've given our best price, so the ball is in your court.

cards.def:
to face something unpleasant bravely
हिंदी: कड़वा घूँट पीना / हिम्मत करके सामना करना
examples: I had to bite the bullet and apologise.
He bit the bullet and paid.
I bit the bullet and told my manager about the mistake.
She bit the bullet and booked the dental appointment.

cards.word: cost an arm and a leg
cards.def:
to be very expensive
हिंदी: बहुत महँगा होना
examples: The car cost an arm and a leg.
Houses there cost an arm and a leg.
The wedding cost an arm and a leg.
Fixing the phone screen cost me an arm and a leg.

cards.def:
slightly ill
हिंदी: तबीयत ठीक न होना
examples: I'm feeling under the weather.
She's under the weather today.
I'm a bit under the weather, so I'll work from home.
The kids were under the weather after the trip.

cards.def:
to reveal a secret
हिंदी: राज़ खोल देना
examples: Who spilled the beans about the party?
He spilled the beans.
Don't spill the beans about the surprise party.
My sister spilled the beans about my new job before I could.

cards.word: let the cat out of the bag
cards.def:
to reveal a secret by mistake
हिंदी: ग़लती से राज़ खोल देना
examples: She let the cat out of the bag.
Don't let the cat out of the bag.
Mum let the cat out of the bag about the gift.
He let the cat out of the bag about the merger in the canteen.

cards.def:
to do something cheaply or carelessly
हिंदी: कम लागत में काम निपटाना / कसर छोड़ना
examples: They cut corners on safety.
Don't cut corners on quality.
The builder cut corners, and now the walls are cracking.
If we cut corners on testing, customers will find the bugs.

cards.def:
to stop working for the day
हिंदी: आज का काम बंद करना
examples: Let's call it a day.
We worked till six, then called it a day.
It's nearly nine; let's call it a day.
After painting two rooms, we called it a day.

cards.def:
back to the beginning
हिंदी: फिर शुरुआत से
examples: The deal collapsed; we're back to square one.
We're back to square one.
The client rejected the design, so we're back to square one.
I lost my notes and was back to square one.

cards.def:
to become nervous before something
हिंदी: ऐन मौक़े पर घबरा जाना
examples: He got cold feet before the wedding.
She got cold feet.
I got cold feet before my first presentation.
The buyer got cold feet and cancelled the flat deal.

cards.def:
in trouble
हिंदी: मुसीबत में
examples: He's in hot water with the boss.
She landed in hot water.
He'll be in hot water if he misses another deadline.
The company is in hot water over the data leak.

cards.def:
undecided
हिंदी: असमंजस में
examples: I'm still on the fence about it.
He's on the fence.
I'm on the fence about buying a new phone.
Many voters are still on the fence.

cards.def:
to give up
हिंदी: हार मान लेना
examples: He refused to throw in the towel.
She threw in the towel.
Don't throw in the towel after one failed interview.
The startup threw in the towel after two years.

cards.def:
the final problem that makes you lose patience
हिंदी: सब्र का आख़िरी बूँद
examples: His rudeness was the last straw.
That was the last straw.
Being late for the third time was the last straw for the manager.
The rent increase was the last straw, so we moved.

cards.def:
something good that seemed bad
हिंदी: छिपा हुआ वरदान
examples: Losing the job was a blessing in disguise.
It turned out a blessing in disguise.
Missing the train was a blessing in disguise; I met an old friend.
The rain was a blessing in disguise for the farmers.

cards.def:
very common
हिंदी: आम / बहुत सस्ता और सामान्य
examples: Such shops are a dime a dozen.
Good ideas are a dime a dozen.
Phone repair shops are a dime a dozen in this market.
Online courses are a dime a dozen, but good ones are rare.

cards.def:
to make a bad situation worse
हिंदी: आग में घी डालना
examples: His comment added fuel to the fire.
Don't add fuel to the fire.
Shouting back will only add fuel to the fire.
The rumours added fuel to the fire between the teams.

cards.def:
looking in the wrong place
हिंदी: ग़लत जगह कोशिश करना
examples: You're barking up the wrong tree.
They were barking up the wrong tree.
If you think I took your pen, you're barking up the wrong tree.
The police were barking up the wrong tree for weeks.

cards.word: bite off more than you can chew
cards.def:
to take on too much
हिंदी: क्षमता से ज़्यादा काम ले लेना
examples: He bit off more than he could chew.
Don't bite off more than you can chew.
I bit off more than I could chew by taking two jobs.
Don't bite off more than you can chew on your first project.

cards.def:
to work late into the night
हिंदी: देर रात तक जागकर काम करना
examples: She burned the midnight oil before exams.
We burned the midnight oil.
We burned the midnight oil to finish the proposal.
Students burn the midnight oil before board exams.

cards.def:
to destroy relationships
हिंदी: रिश्ते बिगाड़ देना
examples: Don't burn your bridges when you resign.
He burned bridges with his boss.
Be polite when you leave a company; never burn bridges.
He burned bridges with his old friends after the argument.

cards.word: by the skin of your teeth
cards.def:
only just
हिंदी: बाल-बाल बचकर
examples: He passed by the skin of his teeth.
We escaped by the skin of our teeth.
I caught the flight by the skin of my teeth.
The team won by the skin of their teeth.

cards.def:
to find someone doing wrong
हिंदी: रंगे हाथों पकड़ना
examples: The thief was caught red-handed.
They caught him red-handed.
The shopkeeper caught the boy red-handed stealing sweets.
She was caught red-handed copying in the exam.

cards.def:
regardless of the weather or circumstances
हिंदी: चाहे कुछ भी हो
examples: I'll be there come rain or shine.
He walks daily, come rain or shine.
The milkman comes every morning, come rain or shine.
Our team meets every Monday, come rain or shine.

cards.def:
to worry about the past
हिंदी: बीती बात पर रोना
examples: There's no use crying over spilt milk.
Don't cry over spilt milk.
The deal is lost; don't cry over spilt milk.
Crying over spilt milk won't change your marks.

cards.word: cross that bridge when we come to it
cards.def:
deal with a problem when it happens
हिंदी: जब वक़्त आएगा तब देखेंगे
examples: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
Let's cross that bridge later.
If the flight is cancelled, we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
Don't worry about the visa yet; cross that bridge when we come to it.

cards.def:
a very small amount compared to the need
हिंदी: ऊँट के मुँह में जीरा
examples: Her donation was a drop in the ocean.
It's a drop in the ocean.
The government's aid was a drop in the ocean.
Saving a hundred rupees is a drop in the ocean for a house.

cards.def:
an obvious issue nobody mentions
हिंदी: ऐसा बड़ा मुद्दा जिस पर कोई बात नहीं करता
examples: Money is the elephant in the room.
Let's address the elephant in the room.
The layoffs were the elephant in the room at the party.
Nobody mentioned the elephant in the room: the delay.

cards.word: every cloud has a silver lining
cards.def:
there is good in every bad situation
हिंदी: हर बुराई में अच्छाई छिपी होती है
examples: Cheer up, every cloud has a silver lining.
Remember, every cloud has a silver lining.
I lost my job but found a better one; every cloud has a silver lining.
The lockdown was hard, but every cloud has a silver lining.

cards.def:
someone in unfamiliar surroundings
हिंदी: अनजान माहौल में असहज इंसान
examples: He felt like a fish out of water.
She was a fish out of water there.
As a vegetarian at the barbecue, I felt like a fish out of water.
He was a fish out of water at the fashion show.

cards.def:
to become uncontrollable
हिंदी: क़ाबू से बाहर होना
examples: The party got out of hand.
Things got out of hand.
The argument got out of hand, and someone called the police.
Spending can get out of hand during festival sales.

cards.def:
to ignore someone deliberately
हिंदी: जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना
examples: She gave him the cold shoulder.
They gave me the cold shoulder.
After the argument, my friend gave me the cold shoulder.
The team gave the new manager the cold shoulder at first.

cards.def:
to make more effort than expected
हिंदी: उम्मीद से ज़्यादा मेहनत करना
examples: She goes the extra mile for clients.
He went the extra mile.
The hotel staff went the extra mile to make our stay special.
Go the extra mile for customers, and they'll come back.

cards.def:
to study hard
हिंदी: जमकर पढ़ाई करना
examples: I need to hit the books tonight.
He hit the books before exams.
Exams are next week, so it's time to hit the books.
She hit the books every evening after work.

cards.def:
to start a journey
हिंदी: सफ़र पर निकल पड़ना
examples: Let's hit the road early.
We hit the road at dawn.
We need to hit the road by six to avoid traffic.
After lunch, the family hit the road for Goa.

cards.def:
to go to bed
हिंदी: सोने चले जाना
examples: I'm tired; I'll hit the sack.
He hit the sack early.
I have an early flight, so I'll hit the sack now.
The kids hit the sack right after dinner.

cards.def:
to wait and be patient
हिंदी: ज़रा रुकिए / धीरज रखिए
examples: Hold your horses, I'm coming.
Hold your horses!
Hold your horses; we haven't got approval yet.
Hold your horses before you book the tickets.

cards.def:
in the same situation
हिंदी: एक ही हालात में
examples: We're all in the same boat.
They're in the same boat.
Everyone in the office is in the same boat with the new rules.
All new joiners are in the same boat, so help each other.

cards.def:
to act too early
हिंदी: जल्दबाज़ी करना
examples: Don't jump the gun.
He jumped the gun and announced it.
The newspaper jumped the gun and announced the wrong winner.
Don't jump the gun; wait for the official results.

cards.def:
to watch carefully
हिंदी: नज़र रखना
examples: Keep an eye on the kids.
Keep an eye on the clock.
Can you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
Keep an eye on your inbox for the offer letter.

cards.word: kill two birds with one stone
cards.def:
to achieve two things in one go
हिंदी: एक तीर से दो शिकार
examples: I'll kill two birds with one stone.
It kills two birds with one stone.
I visited my parents and the bank in one trip, killing two birds with one stone.
Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone: exercise and savings.

cards.def:
to try every possible way
हिंदी: कोई कसर नहीं छोड़ना
examples: Police left no stone unturned.
She left no stone unturned.
We left no stone unturned to find the lost ring.
The lawyer left no stone unturned in preparing the case.

cards.def:
to avoid reopening an old problem
हिंदी: पुरानी बात को मत कुरेदो
examples: Let sleeping dogs lie.
It's better to let sleeping dogs lie.
Don't mention the old fight; let sleeping dogs lie.
The manager decided to let sleeping dogs lie about the mistake.

cards.word: light at the end of the tunnel
cards.def:
hope after a difficult time
हिंदी: मुश्किल के बाद उम्मीद की किरण
examples: I can see light at the end of the tunnel.
There's light at the end of the tunnel.
After months of treatment, she sees light at the end of the tunnel.
With one exam left, there's light at the end of the tunnel.

cards.def:
to earn just enough to live
हिंदी: गुज़ारा चलाना
examples: It's hard to make ends meet.
They barely make ends meet.
Many families work two jobs to make ends meet.
Students take part-time jobs to make ends meet.

cards.def:
to lose an opportunity
हिंदी: मौक़ा गँवा देना
examples: He missed the boat on that deal.
Don't miss the boat.
I missed the boat on buying shares when they were cheap.
Apply now or you'll miss the boat.

cards.def:
extremely happy
हिंदी: बेहद ख़ुश
examples: She was on cloud nine after the win.
I'm on cloud nine.
He was on cloud nine after his first salary.
The couple was on cloud nine on their wedding day.

cards.def:
suddenly and unexpectedly
हिंदी: अचानक / बिना किसी संकेत के
examples: He called me out of the blue.
The news came out of the blue.
Out of the blue, my old teacher sent me a message.
The manager resigned out of the blue.

cards.def:
to joke with someone
हिंदी: मज़ाक़ करना / खिंचाई करना
examples: Are you pulling my leg?
He's just pulling your leg.
Don't worry, I'm only pulling your leg.
He pulled my leg about the exam being cancelled.

cards.def:
to try harder to improve
हिंदी: ज़रा सुधर जाओ / मेहनत बढ़ाओ
examples: You need to pull your socks up.
Pull your socks up before exams.
If you want the promotion, you'll have to pull your socks up.
The team needs to pull its socks up after two bad months.

cards.def:
to spoil someone's plans or joy
हिंदी: ख़ुशी में खलल डालना
examples: Sorry to rain on your parade.
Don't rain on my parade.
I hate to rain on your parade, but the event is cancelled.
A sudden storm rained on our parade at the picnic.

cards.def:
a rough practical guide
हिंदी: मोटा नियम
examples: As a rule of thumb, save ten percent.
A rule of thumb is to ask first.
As a rule of thumb, drink eight glasses of water a day.
A good rule of thumb is to sleep on big decisions.

cards.def:
to agree
हिंदी: एकमत होना
examples: We don't see eye to eye on this.
They see eye to eye.
My father and I don't see eye to eye on politics.
The partners finally saw eye to eye on the budget.

cards.def:
to avoid taking sides
हिंदी: तटस्थ बने रहना
examples: Stop sitting on the fence.
He sits on the fence.
You can't sit on the fence forever; choose a side.
The manager sat on the fence during the team argument.

cards.def:
said when the person you mention appears
हिंदी: नाम लिया और शैतान हाज़िर
examples: Speak of the devil, here she comes.
Speak of the devil!
Speak of the devil, here comes Rahul now.
We were just talking about you, speak of the devil!

cards.def:
to be the most impressive
हिंदी: महफ़िल लूट लेना
examples: The child stole the show.
Her performance stole the show.
The little girl stole the show at the dance competition.
The dessert stole the show at dinner.

cards.word: take it with a pinch of salt
cards.def:
to not believe completely
हिंदी: बात पर पूरा यक़ीन न करना
examples: Take his claims with a pinch of salt.
Take the rumour with a pinch of salt.
Online reviews should be taken with a pinch of salt.
Take his promises of a quick raise with a pinch of salt.

cards.def:
a small visible part of a big problem
हिंदी: बड़ी समस्या का छोटा-सा हिस्सा
examples: These complaints are the tip of the iceberg.
That's just the tip of the iceberg.
The leaking tap was the tip of the iceberg; the whole pipe was rotten.
Those two bugs are just the tip of the iceberg.

cards.def:
in good and bad times
हिंदी: हर हाल में
examples: They stayed together through thick and thin.
He supported me through thick and thin.
My college friends have stood by me through thick and thin.
A good partner supports you through thick and thin.

cards.def:
time passes quickly
हिंदी: वक़्त पंख लगाकर उड़ता है
examples: Time flies when you're busy.
Time flies!
Time flies; my son is already in college.
We talked for hours; time flies with old friends.

cards.def:
to make things worse
हिंदी: ज़ख़्म पर नमक छिड़कना
examples: To add insult to injury, he laughed.
Adding insult to injury, it rained.
My flight was delayed, and to add insult to injury, they lost my bag.
He was late, and to add insult to injury, he forgot the files.

cards.def:
to ignore something wrong on purpose
हिंदी: जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना
examples: Officials turned a blind eye to it.
He turned a blind eye.
The teacher turned a blind eye to the students' chatting.
We can't turn a blind eye to safety problems.

cards.def:
to persuade by pressure
हिंदी: दबाव डालकर मनाना
examples: He twisted my arm to join.
You don't need to twist my arm.
My friends twisted my arm to come to the party.
I didn't want dessert, but she twisted my arm.

cards.def:
undecided
हिंदी: अधर में / तय नहीं
examples: Our plans are up in the air.
It's still up in the air.
The office move is still up in the air.
My holiday plans are up in the air until my leave is approved.

cards.word: a taste of your own medicine
cards.def:
being treated the way you treat others
हिंदी: जैसा किया वैसा भरा
examples: He got a taste of his own medicine.
Give him a taste of his own medicine.
The prankster got a taste of his own medicine when they tricked him.
She always interrupts, so we gave her a taste of her own medicine.

cards.def:
a big fuss about something small
हिंदी: मामूली बात पर बड़ा हंगामा
examples: It was a storm in a teacup.
The row was a storm in a teacup.
The argument about the seating plan was a storm in a teacup.
Don't worry; it's a storm in a teacup and will pass.

cards.word: at the drop of a hat
cards.def:
immediately
हिंदी: ज़रा-सी बात पर तुरंत
examples: He'd fight at the drop of a hat.
She'd help at the drop of a hat.
My grandmother can make tea at the drop of a hat.
He'll travel for work at the drop of a hat.

cards.def:
doing something late is better than not
हिंदी: देर आए दुरुस्त आए
examples: Better late than never.
You came; better late than never.
He finally paid me back; better late than never.
I started learning English at forty; better late than never.

cards.def:
to stop yourself from speaking
हिंदी: ज़बान दबा लेना
examples: I had to bite my tongue.
She bit her tongue.
I bit my tongue when the client criticised my work.
Bite your tongue before you say something you'll regret.

cards.def:
to boast
हिंदी: अपनी तारीफ़ आप करना
examples: He loves to blow his own trumpet.
Don't blow your own trumpet.
She did great work but never blew her own trumpet.
In interviews, it's okay to blow your own trumpet a little.

cards.def:
a sudden shock
हिंदी: अचानक आई आफ़त / ख़बर
examples: The news was a bolt from the blue.
His resignation was a bolt from the blue.
The layoffs came as a bolt from the blue.
Her decision to move abroad was a bolt from the blue.

cards.def:
good luck
हिंदी: शुभकामनाएँ
examples: Break a leg tonight!
Break a leg at your audition.
Break a leg in your presentation tomorrow!
The actors told each other to break a leg before the show.

cards.def:
to make peace
हिंदी: पुरानी दुश्मनी भूलना
examples: They buried the hatchet.
It's time to bury the hatchet.
The two neighbours buried the hatchet after years of fighting.
Let's bury the hatchet and work together.

cards.def:
very quickly
हिंदी: तेज़ी से
examples: Sales are growing by leaps and bounds.
He improved by leaps and bounds.
Her English has improved by leaps and bounds.
The city has grown by leaps and bounds in ten years.

cards.def:
to be in control
हिंदी: फ़ैसले लेना / हुक्म चलाना
examples: She calls the shots in the office.
Who calls the shots here?
In our house, my mother calls the shots.
The client calls the shots on the final design.

cards.def:
a feeling of resentment
हिंदी: मन में कड़वाहट / अकड़
examples: He has a chip on his shoulder.
She carries a chip on her shoulder.
He has a chip on his shoulder because he wasn't promoted.
Don't carry a chip on your shoulder about your past.

cards.def:
a narrow escape
हिंदी: बाल-बाल बचना
examples: That was a close shave.
It was a close shave with the truck.
We nearly missed the train; that was a close shave.
The cyclist had a close shave with a bus.

cards.def:
to return to the starting point
हिंदी: घूमकर फिर वहीं आ जाना
examples: Life came full circle.
We've come full circle.
She started as a teacher and, after years in business, came full circle.
The fashion of the seventies has come full circle.

cards.def:
to get to the point
हिंदी: सीधे मुद्दे पर आना
examples: Let's cut to the chase.
Cut to the chase and tell me.
Let's cut to the chase: what's your best price?
The manager cut to the chase and announced the changes.

cards.def:
practical and sensible
हिंदी: ज़मीन से जुड़ा / सरल स्वभाव का
examples: She is very down to earth.
He's a down-to-earth man.
Despite his fame, the actor is very down to earth.
We need a down to earth plan, not big dreams.

cards.def:
harder to do than to say
हिंदी: कहना आसान, करना मुश्किल
examples: Quitting is easier said than done.
Easier said than done.
Saving money is easier said than done.
Waking up at five is easier said than done.

cards.def:
to accept the consequences
हिंदी: नतीजा भुगतना
examples: He had to face the music.
It's time to face the music.
After breaking the vase, he had to face the music.
The company had to face the music after the scandal.

cards.def:
to start something
हिंदी: शुरुआत करना
examples: Let's get the ball rolling.
She got the ball rolling.
I'll get the ball rolling by introducing myself.
Let's get the ball rolling on the wedding plans.

cards.word: go back to the drawing board
cards.def:
to start planning again
हिंदी: नए सिरे से योजना बनाना
examples: It failed; back to the drawing board.
We must go back to the drawing board.
The investors said no, so we had to go back to the drawing board.
If the test fails, we'll go back to the drawing board.

cards.def:
to fail spectacularly
हिंदी: बुरी तरह नाकाम होना
examples: The plan went down in flames.
His career went down in flames.
The new product went down in flames within a month.
His attempt to impress the boss went down in flames.

cards.def:
very jealous
हिंदी: ईर्ष्या से जलना
examples: She was green with envy.
He turned green with envy.
I was green with envy when I saw her new car.
His friends were green with envy about his trip to Europe.

cards.def:
to persevere
हिंदी: डटे रहना
examples: Hang in there, it gets better.
Just hang in there.
Hang in there; the exams will be over soon.
The first months of a new job are hard, but hang in there.

cards.def:
to be kind
हिंदी: दया करो
examples: Have a heart and help him.
Please have a heart.
Have a heart and let the child have one more sweet.
Have a heart; he's been working since morning.

cards.def:
deeply in love
हिंदी: प्यार में पूरी तरह डूबा
examples: He's head over heels in love.
She fell head over heels.
They were head over heels for each other in college.
She's head over heels about her new puppy.

cards.def:
just in time
हिंदी: ऐन वक़्त पर
examples: We arrived in the nick of time.
He escaped in the nick of time.
The ambulance arrived in the nick of time.
I submitted the form in the nick of time.

cards.def:
it's not difficult
हिंदी: यह कोई कठिन काम नहीं
examples: It's not rocket science.
Cooking isn't rocket science.
Booking a ticket online is not rocket science.
Don't worry, it's not rocket science; I'll show you.

cards.def:
to join a popular trend
हिंदी: भीड़ के साथ हो लेना / चलन में शामिल होना
examples: Everyone jumped on the bandwagon.
Don't jump on the bandwagon.
Many brands jumped on the bandwagon of healthy snacks.
He jumped on the bandwagon and bought crypto at its peak.

cards.def:
to stay positive
हिंदी: हौसला बनाए रखना
examples: Keep your chin up.
Keep your chin up, it'll pass.
Keep your chin up; you'll find a better job.
The coach told the team to keep their chins up after the loss.

cards.def:
to learn how things work
हिंदी: काम के तौर-तरीक़े सीखना
examples: She is learning the ropes.
It takes time to learn the ropes.
The new intern is still learning the ropes.
My senior helped me learn the ropes in my first month.

cards.def:
to relax and enjoy
हिंदी: बेफ़िक्र होकर मौज करना
examples: Let your hair down tonight.
She let her hair down at the party.
After the exams, the students let their hair down.
It's the office party, so let your hair down.

cards.def:
a sudden stroke of luck
हिंदी: अचानक क़िस्मत चमकना
examples: Winning was a stroke of luck.
It was a stroke of luck.
Finding a parking spot right outside was a stroke of luck.
Meeting my mentor at that event was a real stroke of luck.

cards.def:
to tell briefly
हिंदी: बात छोटी करना
examples: To make a long story short, we left.
Make a long story short.
To make a long story short, I got the job.
To make a long story short, the trip was cancelled.

cards.def:
an obvious decision
हिंदी: सीधा-सादा फ़ैसला
examples: Taking the offer was a no-brainer.
It's a no-brainer.
Choosing the flat near the metro was a no-brainer.
Getting health insurance is a no-brainer.

cards.def:
freed from responsibility
हिंदी: ज़िम्मेदारी से बरी
examples: He's off the hook now.
You're off the hook.
The real thief was found, so he's off the hook.
My meeting got cancelled, so I'm off the hook for the presentation.

cards.def:
in a risky situation
हिंदी: ख़तरनाक स्थिति में
examples: He's on thin ice with his boss.
You're skating on thin ice.
After missing three deadlines, he's on thin ice.
You're on thin ice if you keep arriving late.

cards.def:
to decide as things happen
हिंदी: हालात देखकर तय करना
examples: Let's play it by ear.
We'll play it by ear.
We don't have a fixed plan for the weekend; let's play it by ear.
I'll play it by ear and decide after the meeting.

cards.def:
to be firm
हिंदी: सख़्ती से मना करना / अड़ जाना
examples: She put her foot down.
Parents must put their foot down.
My mother put her foot down about late nights.
The manager put her foot down and refused more changes.

cards.def:
to set a higher standard
हिंदी: मानक ऊँचा करना
examples: The film raised the bar.
They raised the bar for quality.
The new phone raised the bar for camera quality.
Her excellent work raised the bar for the whole team.

cards.def:
to sense how people feel
हिंदी: माहौल भाँप लेना
examples: He knows how to read the room.
Learn to read the room.
Read the room before telling jokes at a serious meeting.
A good speaker reads the room and adjusts.

cards.def:
to think overnight before deciding
हिंदी: रातभर सोचकर तय करना
examples: Let me sleep on it.
I'll sleep on it.
The offer sounds good, but I'll sleep on it.
Don't decide now; sleep on it and call me tomorrow.

cards.def:
everything possible
हिंदी: पूरी तरह से / सब कुछ
examples: We gave them the whole nine yards.
She did the whole nine yards.
For the wedding, they went the whole nine yards with lights and music.
The hotel gave us the whole nine yards: flowers, cake and a free upgrade.
